tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Pure white, like other travel sites.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, calendar panels, receipts and bottom sheets that sit on `paper`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy and prices on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `mist`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, conditions (大人2名・1泊2食), dates and footnotes on `paper` and `paper-raised`.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px rules between list rows, table borders and the editorial column rules.

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: Retired as a separate green: the brand frame is ink. Rules, labels, links and the black band.

tokens.name: on-pine
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a `pine` fill.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Highlighter yellow. Only for the hype layer: video stamps, the 神日 badge, underline marks behind one keyword. Never a page background.

tokens.name: on-marker
tokens.usage: Text on a `marker` fill in both themes.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Quiet neutral band behind a featured section.

tokens.name: data-cheap
tokens.usage: Means 安い only: the 神日 cell, the lowest price, cheap bars. White text on it (4.6:1). Never used for labels or links.

tokens.name: on-data-cheap
tokens.usage: Numbers on `data-cheap` and `data-high` fills.

tokens.name: data-near
tokens.usage: Calendar cell within +15% of the lowest price: a light green tint, ink text.

tokens.name: data-warm
tokens.usage: Calendar cell within +35%: neutral light gray, ink text.

tokens.name: data-high
tokens.usage: Means 高い only: a true red for expensive prices and the text in expensive cells (5.4:1 on white). Cells use a light red tint behind it.

tokens.name: data-sold
tokens.usage: Sold out: drawn as diagonal stripes so it never reads as a price tier; always with the word 満室.

tokens.name: rakuten-cta
tokens.usage: The booking button (楽天トラベルで空室を見る／予約へ): black with white text. The only filled black button; red is never used for buttons.

tokens.name: data-high-tint
tokens.usage: Background of an expensive calendar cell, with `data-high` text.

families.mincho: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Hiragino Sans", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", "Noto Sans JP", "Noto Sans CJK JP", "Yu Gothic", Meiryo, sans-serif
families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Hiragino Sans", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", "Noto Sans JP", "Noto Sans CJK JP", "Yu Gothic", Meiryo, sans-serif
families.label: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Hiragino Sans", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", "Noto Sans JP", "Noto Sans CJK JP", "Yu Gothic", Meiryo, sans-serif

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark only: Archivo 900 at width 118%, uppercase, scaled to span the full content width (1008px on a 1080px video frame).

styles.name: price-xl
styles.usage: The one hero price on a page or video card. Lining numerals. Archivo at width 100%, lining and tabular numerals.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices in lists, rankings and receipts. Archivo at width 100%, lining and tabular numerals.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Page and section headlines on the site. Editorial, calm.

styles.name: hotel-name
styles.usage: Every hotel name, on the site and in video.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: The feature title on a cover, white with the cover title shadow (`shadow-title`). Final 。 in `marker`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 1月6日(水)泊は、5軒中4軒がその宿の最安値でした。

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: 大人2名・1室・1泊2食付きの最安プラン（税込）

styles.name: shout
styles.usage: Video only: the hype copy on stamps and big panels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small Japanese label above headlines and in the running head. No uppercase Latin.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Dates and small figures in calendars and chips; tabular.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between calendar cells.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between stacked blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Opening and closing margin of a feature page on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Editorial panels, the masthead, photos. The default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Calendar cells, badges.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter tabs and the date chips only.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The sticky booking sheet at the bottom of the site.

tokens.name: shadow-video
tokens.usage: Every panel placed over footage in video, so it never blends into the background.

tokens.name: shadow-title
tokens.usage: Only the big feature title on a cover or a hotel name set over footage, so it reads on bright sky.
